metadata.name: Market Access Tariffs
metadata.description: Operator-published tariff snapshot, verified September 2026. Effective rates and currencies are preserved; contract eligibility and conditional charges still apply.
metadata.freshness_note: Enbridge has published October 1, 2026 replacements (CER 10, 11 and 12). These future rates are not used in this September snapshot. Rebuilding alone does not re-verify tariffs.
unit_notes: m3 rates are also converted to per-bbl using 1 m3 = 6.28981077 bbl.
Rows with mixed currency preserve the operator-published CAD and USD components instead of applying a live FX conversion.
Only the filings effective on the September 2026 verification date are included. No cancelled Express 5-9 year table or future October Mainline rate is presented as current.
